My “father” was a ruthless warmonger, 
and my real mother a war widow from an invaded land.
Worse, my father was planning to attack my hometown.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/89fee2c755c9fa60354d15088147bb21cf8d6ebd.png[/img]

notes.title: A monochrome love begins❤️《Life in The Janitor's Room with A JK Girl》is out now🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/5bb3cfff3a0cea823e07d494e3318a2d9750b7a5.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606830


“Hey, mister! I’m here again!”
The janitor’s dull routine changed the day her voice filled the room.
His once colorless life... might just be heading into spring.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/672256c1855488d93ca1c7c0356f93dcd45611a3.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/ae248b1d1d0614b3dc54f168cdb3d442415f5969.jpg[/img]

One day, gyaru schoolgirl Futaba Arisa barges into the janitor’s room
—and falls in love with the place.
Now she skips class just to hang out.
What should the older janitor do?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/b2654c1c0b900f4074e338393cf2d905b52300ac.jpg[/img]

Simple: win her heart!
Talk, learn her story—and maybe pull a prank while she naps.
Raise her affection and unlock date events!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/19c0c9ae756ef6bfcc07230f34718debd8f5669e.jpg[/img]

With 50,000 words of emotional writing and a monochrome art style,
this game is for those who want to care for a lonely girl
—or fall in love with the beauty of a colorless world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606830

notes.title: 《Spiritbound: The Goddess's Quest》store page has been released!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/12a1c3b7d8766689f7f7d6d5666ead7afcfcb960.png[/img]
[h2][b]Add to Wishlist NOW!![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421410/
[hr][/hr]

[h2]＊Story＊[/h2]
All over the world, there are well-known haunted places, and one of them is particularly eye-catching and dangerous...
That place is the ""Haunted House"".
Many people have been abused there, but even the police are helpless about the ghosts.
The troubled people involved decided to hire an exorcist to expel the evil spirits,
But after the exorcism, they found that the evil spirits here are very powerful, and all the spells don't work!
Finally, the frustrated exorcists decided to go to the shrine to ask the goddess for help—
Thus, the goddess's exorcism mission begins!

[h2]＊How to play＊[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/60395a51d54fb97b7b4f5f98b2ac5b78e5d6a2fb.png[/img]
▲Explore the map
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/b1480b9370b8014186a33218b5e98a05b95fe9bd.png[/img]
▲Look for clues base on hints
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/13963689c64ae354849cfcbd528a3321f675b9e6.png[/img]
▲Talk to evil spirits and exorcise them

[h2]＊Character＊[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/07bfb3b00fad3e427278dede20227aefb904b90a.png[/img]
Hatsune, a cute goddess.
She is very interested in human food.

[h2]＊Game Features＊[/h2]
[list]
[*] Simple classic RPG
[*] Easy gameplay without fighting
[*] Watch the story of evil spirits
[*] Includes some voice acting and sound effects

The Kingdom of Costodel.
This is a small kingdom with rich beautiful nature landscape, located in the west of the continent.

The protagonist, Wein, is the only female knight in the Imperial Knight as she spends all day training her sword skills.

Someday, the Imperial Knight suddenly held a training bootcamp.

There are 5 endings depending on your choice in the final night.

Since ancient times, there have been dark beings, demons, that harbor grudges against humans.
Even in modern times, they still exist.
However... there are also those who protect people from these demons.
They are called "exorcists" and have been battling demons since ancient times.
The current head of the prestigious exorcist family, the Kuranashi (Dark Void) family, is "Kuranashi Mari."

One day, Mari rescues a girl named "Aikawa Hiyori" who was attacked by demons.
To help Hiyori, who has lost her exorcist powers due to a womb tattoo,
Mari dedicates herself to the battle against the demons...

This is a classic turn-based RPG with a command-style interface. 
The design is straightforward even for RPG beginners!

[h1]Defeat Scenes (H-Scenes)[/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/3a9b34a7d40274b9458c1d2fad8b913a0ca9364f.png[/img]

If Mari's health points (HP) reach zero in battle, she is defeated,
and will be raped by her opponent. 
The higher Mari's Ero level is, the more explicit and debauched Mari becomes. 
Additionally, in some scenes, specific Debuffs will lead to unique variations.

[h1]Event Scenes (H-Events)[/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/511b70e7e8a68297d65f46cffaa6d560e20839cd.png[/img]
During map exploration, choosing certain options highlighted in pink may lead to "H Events"
where Mari is either forced or asked to do lewd things.
These scenes primarily involve interactions with humans, and similar to defeat scenes, 
the higher Mari's Ero level is, the more explicit her actions become. 
Similar to defeat scenes, some events may have unique variations based on specific debuffs.
Furthermore, if Mari's Ero level reaches the maximum of 3, additional scenes may occur.

[h1]Combat H[/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/1aca39fb507a4c6f06f39d994e1088ca0cc9d46a.png[/img]
During combat, attacks from demons have a chance of breaking Mari's armor,
and once demons use H attack after that, "Combat H" will be triggered.
When receiving H attack, Mari's Energy(EP) will be absorbed by demons, and her Ecstasy and Ero level will increase.
In addition, in some combat H, specific Debuffs will lead to unique variations.

[h1]Ecstasy System[/h1]
When receiving H attack in combat, "Ecstasy" will increase.
When Ecstasy reaches 100, Mari cums and becomes unable to move for one turn.
However, her energy will be replenished, and her Max EP, ATK, and SP(Sorcery ATK) will increase by 1.

[h1]Lust System[/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/a4ae18f1d45191e6102cdcc5a642ae12c3253af2.png[/img]
When receiving H attacks, being raped after defeated, and doing lewd things in Events,
Mari's "Lust" will increase.
When Lust is at a certain degree, "Ero Level" will increase, and Mari's reaction in H Scenes will change correspondingly.

[h1]Debuff System[/h1]
Among the demons, some can apply Debuffs on Mari.
When receiving these attacks, Debuffs such as "Lactating" or "Infested" might be applied.
These Debuffs will not only put Mari at a disadvantage in combat, but also trigger specific H Scenes that have unique variations.

[h2]《HAREM！RANCH LIFE DLC 》is released on 072 Project！ [/h2]

[h3]◆The five additional features
1. New female characters
2. Dressing system
3. Season system
4. Additional voice
5. Mining feature[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/f39800d351d5bae2f200f9e5987fbccf99fdd907.jpg[/img]
In addition to the six female characters in the main game, Fiona, the daughter of Olivia who is in the shipping industry, 
and the mayor Ninai, who many players in the previous game were looking forward to, have also been added. 

The  female characters  characters are voiced.
There will be a response voice when giving a gift, and invitation  events will be full voice.

Yui(CV:砂糖しお) 
Kukuru(CV:小町ういら)
Lulu・Ruri(CV:藍沢夏癒)
Hazuki(CV:みもりあいの) 
Coco(CV:餅梨あむ)
Fiona(CV:藤村莉央) 
Ninai(CV:葉月ゆう)
Olivia(CV:碧棺らむだ)

[h3]◼︎Addtional Female Character[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/b816d1af98864e98f5ee32d7cffc2b0a4fbbce09.jpg[/img]
●Fiona（CV:藤村莉央）

A girl with blond hair, heterochromatic eyes, and a white dress.

The daughter of Olivia who is in the shipping industry,
"A loli character who is three years younger than the other female characters."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/b31590d529cb35e757f3bb9d3f5ce8df17894368.jpg[/img]
●Ninai（CV:叶月ゆう）

The mayor of Mello Town.

As a town guide, she will help players in all aspects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/0449beb324445ef9c49a0ce79d542ad5f176dee8.jpg[/img]
●Olivia（CV:碧棺らむだ）

Fiona's mother. As a shipper, 
this blond and busty big sister supports the protagonist in all aspects of his ranch life."

[h3]◼︎Season Feature[/h3]
The appearance of the map changes with the seasons of spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Maybe it also includes places that can only be visited during certain seasons...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/a9ac683f9a30a330d52d34cdef9bd0ca45b978b2.jpg[/img]

[h3]And there are seasonal events.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/67f770f2590dc62993b50f4a8ff7bfa0edf17e34.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/0b6f8b9b2295b7194d48b0c1a5cf59adf5e09d42.jpg[/img]

[h3]◼︎Mining System [/h3]
Mining system feature is added.
Get rare items by exploring!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512670/85b5dd598affc26055387e7729bd84389dc585a2.jpg[/img]

[h3]◼︎Dressing System[/h3]
．Clothes can be purchased at the clothing store in the market.
You can freely mix and match the obtained clothes, and the changes will be reflected in the portrait.
Please choose freely to your like.

The protagonist wakes up in an unknown world.
It's a world ruled by succubi, a world excessively cruel to humans.
To return to their original world, they must defeat the succubus queen.
But when he finally encounter the queen, things aren't as simple as he seem...?
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/a886382446147c6148a043d1e751f2e88ee09b2f.gif[/img]

More varied and challenging enemy designs.

Collect these notes from the victims,
and gradually learn about the habits of the succubi.

you must utilize all the resources you find,
whether it's choosing to evade succubi or defeat them, do your best to find a way out.

Collect resources to upgrade weapons, daggers, guns, hand grenades...
skillfully take down the succubi one by one from a distance,
and finally confront the queen.

Whether you make it out alive, or become a roadside skeleton,
it's all up to your decisions.

notes.title: Heavenly Beauty × Silver Bubble Ninetales is coming out on October 27th!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/a0cbad1feb4c3c68c90642ef56e7db1527adeed8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Heavenly Beauty × Silver Bubble Ninetales[/b] is coming out on October 27th![/h1]

This is an evasion-style RPG game where you dodge bubbles and attempt to seal a beautiful nine-tailed fox spirit. 
Steam version offers full uncensored visuals! 
If you're interested, add it to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2189530

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/e23fb49552cd34eb5ecfdd4fb22c5d1f86acf627.png[/img]
The silver nine-tailed bubble fox " AWAYUKI" appeared in front of the protagonist of the exorcist.
The main character, who has a favorable impression of her, 
be able to resist temptation and seal AWAYUKI...?
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/7c42387a9ac1c668863e4d2c49fcf8be10590993.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/f8e51cfb3fb079490b89cafef8c6dec48b42e9fb.png[/img]
This game consists of two parts: "Evasion" and "Battle."
The evasion part involves action elements and aims to getting close to AWAYUKI before transitioning into the battle part, all while avoiding flying bubbles and hearts. In the battle segment, the goal is to use your skills to damage AWAYUKI while resisting her attacks and temptations.
Each part is distinct yet intertwined, allowing you to enjoy action elements and strategic combat.

When attempting to achieve victory, the difficulty level is quite high, but the game is designed with the assumption that you will be defeated initially.
There's no privilege to winning; even if you lose, you can comfortably retreat to the reminiscence room, so please enjoy to your heart's content.
The gender of the protagonist can be chosen between male and female.
The storyline, gameplay, and overall structure remain the same; only depictions, CGs, and certain text elements will differ based on gender. Furthermore, this concept aims to be a user-friendly game, so despite its rich content, it can be enjoyed with ease!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/47cd931831406a9e3e2d08c53d9d1d1bec54bf6f.png[/img]
[b]Abundant Status Effects[/b]
As a key feature of this genre, the pleasurable pains are richly and densely arrayed this time. Captivating, sensitive, lascivious, brainwashing, sleeping, covered in bubbles, foot fetish, tail fetish, and more...
Although there's only one enemy character, there are around 20 different status effects!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/9cc6bca69508ea2c2a6abae35fb8cbd76d89fd40.jpg[/img]
[b]Intense Scenarios, Casual Gameplay[/b]
After a 2-minute opening (optional), dive into battle with AWAYUKI! There is no exploration or leveling elements, allowing you to immediately enjoy the core aspects of the game.
And after defeat, you're swiftly taken to the reminiscence room. Rich customization features are available, including elements exclusive to the reminiscence room.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/dc44bffe83ef00ac4b3297c56e26fadef62c1697.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439620/_/

▽Story
The village is in crisis due to attacks from goblins, orcs, and other so-called demi-humans.
The villagers realize the need for a large-scale cleanup and plan to burn down the demi-humans' nests.

However, Sister Hidori, who is entrusted by the church to manage the village, opposes the village's decision.

"Ladies and gentlemen, the blessings of the Lord will reach the demi-humans.
It does not wish for cruel acts.
Let us resolve this issue peacefully through dialogue!"

And so, with only one guard, the sister ventures into the depths of the forest...
Heading towards the demi-humans' dwelling.
